turns.reply:
I fixed `Text.append` in `rich/text.py` so that appending a `Text` to itself no longer loops forever. The patch is submitted (1 file changed), and `tests/test_text.py` passes (108 tests).

The cause was that the span-extension generator iterated over `text._spans` while extending that same list, so it never finished. The fix snapshots the source spans into a list first and reads the length into a local before the `self._length` update. I did not reproduce the original hang against the unpatched code; the self-append check I ran returned the correct result after the change. I did not add a regression test.
